title: Handle no value
summary: Ruby: Handle no value. Give name the text Asha.
introduction: nil means no value. The || operator chooses the right side when the left side is nil or false.

blocks.text: Install Ruby 3.1 or later. Save one example as lesson.rb and run ruby lesson.rb in a terminal.
The left value is nil, so the fallback Guest is selected.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Zero and empty strings count as true in Ruby.
